banner.title: Stage 4 done — four down, two to go
banner.body: Aqueduct finished at 02:58. 42.0 miles and 6,450 feet, 7:02 of riding against a planned 7:30. That is four stages out of six, 155 miles ridden, and every one of them ridden faster than the schedule called for. Wheeler and Gold Dust remain: 55 miles and the last of the climbing. Resting now.
